note: No authentication, login, session, or authorization code exists anywhere in product/ — this is a fully public marketing site. The only actor is an anonymous visitor. 'Visitor' is used as roles_allowed on every feature in the features draft. Any additional roles (e.g. an internal admin who receives the emailed leads) live outside this codebase and are not evidenced here.

roles.name: Visitor
roles.note: Anonymous, unauthenticated public user. Can browse all sections and submit the contact form / open the WhatsApp chat. No accounts, permissions, or gated content exist in the code.
